gloss_en: the downward chaining (hishtalshelut) of the Divine severities (gevurot) — the degeneration of holy Gevurah as it descends through the worlds into coarsened form, identified in LM 1:5 with the 'dross of gold' (suspita de-dahava) and manifesting as external fear (fear of things other than God) that blocks the voice in the stopped-up intellect
